stem:
A compound secreted by honeybees to paralyze intruders in their hive is known as 2-heptanone. The formula for this compound is shown.

CH₃ C₄H₈ COCH₃

How many atoms of each element are in one molecule of 2-heptanone?

options.label: A
options.text: 4 carbon atoms, 11 hydrogen atoms, and 1 oxygen atom

options.label: B
options.text: 7 carbon atoms, 14 hydrogen atoms, and 1 oxygen atom

options.label: C
options.text: 7 carbon atoms, 11 hydrogen atoms, and 8 oxygen atoms

options.label: D
options.text: 6 carbon atoms, 14 hydrogen atoms, and 3 oxygen atoms
